message.content:
Here’s a classic, fool‑proof list of ingredients for a moist, chocolate‑loving cake. Feel free to tweak quantities or add extras (like espresso powder or sea salt) to suit your taste.

| Ingredient | Quantity (for a 9‑inch round cake) | Notes |
|------------|------------------------------------|-------|
| All‑purpose flour | 1 ¾ cups (220 g) | Sifted for a lighter crumb |
| Unsweetened cocoa powder | ¾ cup (75 g) | Use a high‑quality Dutch‑process for richer flavor |
| Granulated sugar | 2 cups (400 g) | Can replace half with brown sugar for extra depth |
| Baking powder | 1 ½ tsp | Helps the cake rise |
| Baking soda | 1 ½ tsp | Works with the acidity of the cocoa |
| Salt | 1 tsp | Balances sweetness |
| Eggs | 2 large | Room temperature for better emulsion |
| Whole milk | 1 cup (240 ml) | Room temperature |
| Vegetable oil | ½ cup (120 ml) | Or melted butter for richer flavor |
| Vanilla extract | 2 tsp | Pure vanilla for best aroma |
| Boiling water | 1 cup (240 ml) | Activates cocoa, keeps batter thin |
| Optional: 1 tsp espresso powder |  | Intensifies chocolate flavor |
| Optional: pinch of sea salt |  | Enhances sweetness |

**Optional add‑ins:**
- **Chocolate chips or chunks** (½ cup) – fold in after mixing the batter.
- **Ground nuts** (½ cup) – walnuts or pecans for crunch.
- **Spices** (cinnamon, nutmeg) – a pinch for warmth.

**Pro tip:** For an extra moist cake, replace the milk with buttermilk or add a tablespoon of sour cream or Greek yogurt. Enjoy baking!
